Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly identify the author of "The New New Rules" as Bill Maher. The show "The New New Rules" was hosted by Chelsea Handler, not Bill Maher. Bill Maher hosts "Real Time with Bill Maher." Because the Planner incorrectly assumed the author was Bill Maher from the very first step, all subsequent searches and conclusions were based on a false premise, leading to the wrong answer (January 19, 2018, which is the start of Real Time, not The New New Rules).
